data: Apple's fiscal 2025 (ended September 27, 2025) net sales were about $416.2 billion, up roughly 6% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Gross profit was about $195.2 billion, a gross margin of roughly 46.9%, compared with 46.2% in fiscal 2024. Operating income was about $133.1 billion, an operating margin of roughly 32.0%, compared with about 31.5% the year before. Margins were helped by the mix shift toward Services, which had revenue of about $109.2 billion and a much higher gross margin than Products. These figures come from my recollection of Apple's 10-K rather than a live lookup, so check them against the filing before relying on them.
